news.title: Consumer apprehension grows as US retailers adopt AI-assisted pricing tools

news.title: Trustbut checks if an AI agent's new tests fail without its change
news.dek: Trustbut verifies whether an AI agent's new tests fail when its changes are removed.
news.aiSummary: Trustbut is a tool that validates AI agent contributions by checking if the new tests fail without the agent's specific code changes. This process ensures that the tests are actually relevant to the modifications made by the AI.

news.title: trunk/862dafe801376206e6f37dd27777701111550633: [GHF] Refresh reverted stack branches with the merge bot (#199717)
news.dek:
Impact:  pytorchmergebot revert flow ( trymerge.py --revert ): after a non-ghstack revert has landed and reopened its PRs, it reads their stack and may push merge commits to their branches. PRs outside a stack, fork PRs and dry runs get no push and no comment 
 Risk:  low 
 What
news.aiSummary: This update modifies the PyTorch merge bot's revert flow to refresh reverted stack branches by pushing merge commits to their branches after a non-ghstack revert lands. The change ensures that PRs within a stack are updated, while PRs outside a stack, fork PRs, and dry runs are excluded from receiving pushes or comments.

news.title: trunk/14c5b96bfa18be17d9845bbb060a095fc762ca8c: [GHF] Merge GitHub-native PR stacks with the merge bot (#199714)
news.dek: Impact:  pytorchmergebot merge flow ( trymerge.py ) for same-repo PRs based on another PR's branch in a main-based GitHub-native stack, refused today. ghstack PRs, fork PRs and PRs on the default branch are unchanged; other PRs on a non-default base still get a refusal, after one
news.aiSummary: A recent update to the PyTorch merge bot allows it to process GitHub-native pull request stacks where a PR is based on another PR's branch within the same repository. Previously, this specific configuration was refused, but it is now supported while leaving ghstack, fork, and default branch PRs unchanged.

news.aiSummary: The pytorchbot rebase flow has been updated to handle GitHub-native pull request stacks differently. Instead of force-pushing rebased commits, the bot now merges the target branch into the stack's branches when processing rebase requests.
